en.shortDescription: Background jobs and workflow automation platform
en.longDescription:
Trigger.dev is an open-source platform for long-running background jobs and workflows in TypeScript.

This template runs the Trigger webapp with PostgreSQL and Redis for self-hosted orchestration.

de.longDescription:

fr.shortDescription: Plateforme de jobs d'arrière-plan et d'automatisation de workflows
